## What this changes / 改了什麼

<!-- One or two sentences, and the issue it fixes if any. / 一兩句話；修哪個 issue 也寫上。 -->

## Checklist / 確認

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally / 本機 `npm test` 全部通過
- [ ] No tokens, passwords, keys or customer data in code, tests or screenshots / 程式、測試、截圖都沒有 Token、密碼、金鑰或客戶資料
- [ ] New UI text has an English entry in `public/i18n/en.js` (the `i18n-test` checks this) / 新增的介面文字在 `public/i18n/en.js` 補了英文
- [ ] Database change? Added a numbered file in `migrations/` and updated `src/schema.sql` / 有改資料表：`migrations/` 加了編號檔、也同步 `src/schema.sql`
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/ai-integration.md`) if behavior changed / 行為有變就更新文件
